title: Would You Rather
description: Two choices, no right answer. Guess how the room splits.

questions.question: Would you rather be able to fly or be invisible?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes late or 20 minutes early?
Would you rather give up coffee or give up dessert?
Would you rather live by the beach or in the mountains?
Would you rather know how you die or when you die?
Would you rather have no phone or no car for a year?
Would you rather be famous or rich?
Would you rather time-travel to the past or the future?
Would you rather only whisper or only shout?
Would you rather fight one horse-sized duck or 100 duck-sized horses?
Would you rather be the funniest or the smartest person in the room?
Would you rather have a rewind button or a pause button for your life?
Would you rather read minds or see the future?
Would you rather never use social media again or never watch TV again?
Would you rather win the lottery or live twice as long?
Would you rather explore space or the deep ocean?
Would you rather be a famous singer or a famous athlete?
Would you rather have summer or winter all year?
Would you rather talk to animals or speak every human language?
Would you rather have a personal chef or a personal driver?
